method: APEx transferred to Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 with full-parameter GRPO

optimization.algorithm: official GRPO advantage and clipped policy loss
optimization.gradient_accumulation: full declared query batch including every sampled group
optimization.checkpoints: Fixed final checkpoint for each stage; no test-based selection; inference checkpoints omit Adam state

clbench.primary: Predeclared candidate 0 before current batch updates; first task included
clbench.other_rollouts: All four kept and charged to each method; no best-of-four scoring
clbench.reward_source: Official no-GT judges and skill alignment, with no evaluator result accepted by learning boundary
clbench.updates: Planner full parameters only; after entire 8-query batch; memory and skills updated after batch
clbench.reset: All model parameters, optimizer and memories reset by domain, seed and arm
clbench.format: Official yes/no and balanced-think format rule; native tasks ending before a decision receive zero format point
clbench.transfer: CLBench native action schema; replan at turn 9 if active; no action after terminal outcome; all arms have identical environment/action budgets; planner/writer/judge costs separate
clbench.failure: Keep unscored failures separately; never fill with zeros; compare scored common canonical pairs

adaptations: All three policy roles initialized independently from the existing Qwen4B checkpoint, not the paper 7B/8B models
Official image captions replace image pixels; text search only
Single policy GPU with CPU FP32 AdamW masters and sequential role swaps replaces 8-GPU FSDP/veRL launch; original GRPO functions reused
Judge weights BF16 with FP8 E5M2 KV cache, TP2 on two A100 40GB devices
Writer history split is by bound input before grouping, not random overlapping groups; new trajectories and reward inputs fully bound
Exact normalized E5 IndexFlatIP wiki25 in RAM; no compressed retrieval index
Preserve final inference checkpoints and all compressed rollouts; no claim of optimizer-resumable checkpoint
Official Planner duplicate inputs deduplicated; all conflicting-reference input groups quarantined before training
CLBench native environments and first-attempt continual evaluation replace the paper QA test loop; not original seven-benchmark reproduction
Malformed Writer structure that would crash the original parser is logged and assigned zero reward; valid structures retain original reward computation
